g.text: 模块化真空镀膜系统装置图（溅射 + 离子束铣）
DN100CF 三腔布局：装载锁 / 磁控溅射腔 / 离子束铣腔

g.data-purpose: structural elements: component glyphs and connections

g.title: 装载锁 Load lock
g.desc: source quote: One chamber serves as a load lock and is equipped with a quick-access door, a transfer rod, an electrical feedthrough, a gas inlet, and a roughing pump.

g.title: 快开门 Quick-access door
g.desc: source quote: One chamber serves as a load lock and is equipped with a quick-access door, a transfer rod, an electrical feedthrough, a gas inlet, and a roughing pump.

g.title: 传输杆 Transfer rod
g.desc: source quote: The transfer rod is reinforced to support the weight of the complete sample-holder assembly.

g.title: 电馈通 Electrical feedthrough
g.desc: source quote: One chamber serves as a load lock and is equipped with a quick-access door, a transfer rod, an electrical feedthrough, a gas inlet, and a roughing pump.

g.title: 进气口 Gas inlet
g.desc: source quote: One chamber serves as a load lock and is equipped with a quick-access door, a transfer rod, an electrical feedthrough, a gas inlet, and a roughing pump.

g.title: 粗抽泵（涡旋泵）Scroll pump（装载锁）
g.desc: source quote: After loading a sample, the load lock is pumped with a separate scroll pump to a pressure of p ≈ 10⁻¹ mbar within about t = 4 min before the gate valve is opened.

g.title: 闸阀 Gate valve
g.desc: source quote: The load lock is separated from the main chambers by a gate valve.

g.title: 溅射腔（4× 2英寸磁控溅射源）
g.desc: source quote: One of them is equipped with four 2-inch magnetron sputter sources installed on O-ring sealed rods. The working distance can be adjusted between 52 mm and 150 mm.

g.title: 磁控溅射源 ×4（O圈密封杆安装）
g.desc: source quote: One of them is equipped with four 2-inch magnetron sputter sources installed on O-ring sealed rods.

g.title: 样品架 Sample holder（带屏蔽板/快门）
g.desc: source quote: The mechanical design is based on a central assembly attached to the transfer rod, a vacuum-compatible stepper motor, bearing supports, and the shield.

g.title: 离子束铣腔（含离子源）
g.desc: source quote: The second process chamber contains an ion-beam source for milling and surface preparation.

g.title: 离子束源 Ion-beam source
g.desc: source quote: The other one is equipped with an ion-beam source, a turbomolecular pump of the 200 to 300 l/s pumping speed class, and a full-range pressure gauge.

g.title: 分子泵 Turbomolecular pump
g.desc: source quote: The turbomolecular pump remains at full speed during sample loading and is throttled to a low-speed mode with 70% of its nominal speed during deposition to reduce the mechanical load at high pressure and allow for higher working pressures.

g.title: 全量程真空计 Full-range pressure gauge
g.desc: source quote: The other one is equipped with an ion-beam source, a turbomolecular pump of the 200 to 300 l/s pumping speed class, and a full-range pressure gauge.

g.title: 前级涡旋泵 Scroll pump（分子泵前级）
g.desc: source quote: The required backing pressure is provided by a small scroll pump.

g.title: 孔径板 Aperture plates（DN100CF 法兰）
g.desc: source quote: Together with aperture plates mounted in the DN100CF flanges, this geometry reduces direct cross-contamination between neighboring sources and allows pre-sputtering of the sources.

g.title: 联锁控制器 Interlock controller
g.desc: source quote: The electronic infrastructure includes an interlock controller, DC and RF power supplies, and a time-based process control system for deposition and ion-beam milling processes.

g.title: DC/RF 电源 DC and RF power supplies
g.desc: source quote: The electronic infrastructure includes an interlock controller, DC and RF power supplies, and a time-based process control system for deposition and ion-beam milling processes.

g.title: 时序过程控制系统 Time-based process control
g.desc: source quote: The electronic infrastructure includes an interlock controller, DC and RF power supplies, and a time-based process control system for deposition and ion-beam milling processes.
source quote: One chamber serves as a load lock and is equipped with a quick-access door, a transfer rod, an electrical feedthrough, a gas inlet, and a roughing pump.
source quote: After loading a sample, the load lock is pumped with a separate scroll pump to a pressure of p ≈ 10⁻¹ mbar within about t = 4 min before the gate valve is opened.

source quote: Axial motion of the transfer rod moves the sample from the load lock into the process chambers, while rotation of the transfer rod defines the angular position of the sample with respect to the deposition or milling sources, see Figure 4.
source quote: The load lock is separated from the main chambers by a gate valve.
source quote: Our design reaches a base pressure of p = 5·10⁻⁸ mbar without bakeout.
source quote: The required backing pressure is provided by a small scroll pump.
source quote: During standard deposition, the sample can be aligned facing one selected magnetron source.
source quote: Integrating ion-beam milling into the same compact vacuum system enables controlled material removal, surface cleaning, and subsequent deposition without breaking vacuum.
source quote: The other one is equipped with an ion-beam source, a turbomolecular pump of the 200 to 300 l/s pumping speed class, and a full-range pressure gauge.
source quote: A pair of bevel gears transmits the vacuum motor torque to a 3-inch sample disk, enabling rotation of the substrate during deposition.
source quote: The electronic infrastructure includes an interlock controller, DC and RF power supplies, and a time-based process control system for deposition and ion-beam milling processes.
source quote: The electronic infrastructure includes an interlock controller, DC and RF power supplies, and a time-based process control system for deposition and ion-beam milling processes.
source quote: The electronic infrastructure includes an interlock controller, DC and RF power supplies, and a time-based process control system for deposition and ion-beam milling processes.
source quote: In contrast to conventional systems, the sample holder remains mechanically connected to the transfer rod during loading, transfer, deposition, and ion-beam milling.

材料: 结构铝制；锁紧杆不锈钢
运行模式: 装载时全速；镀膜时降至 70%
